beats.intent: ThinkSR runs a low-resolution image through encoding, windowing, repeated shared DQ-CTM thought ticks, and decoding.
beats.claim: ThinkSR end to end: encoder, windows, shared DQ-CTM ticks, decoder.
beats.narration: The method keeps a dense carrier while a compact thought process reads and updates it. The encoder turns the input image into features. Windowing groups those features for local processing. DQ-CTM repeats its thought ticks with shared parameters. The decoder turns the updated dense field back into a super-resolved image.

params.headline: ThinkSR keeps dense output while thought stays compact
params.note: The recurrence returns to the thought stage itself.

beats.intent: The carrier equation defines a dense feature field first, then partitions that same field into windows without dropping tokens.
beats.claim: A persistent dense carrier, read and updated by a compact thought process.
beats.narration: The equation starts by naming the dense carrier that the rest of the method will preserve. The encoder maps the low-resolution image into that carrier field. The window partition operates on the carrier, rather than replacing it. The windowed tokens remain tied to the same dense field.

params.headline: The dense carrier is encoded before it is windowed

terms.label: encoder applied to the low-resolution image
window partition of the dense field

beats.intent: DQ-CTM-SR is not the smallest model in the comparison; its 1.129 million parameters are second largest among the five methods.
beats.claim: ×4 lightweight super-resolution, average over five benchmarks.
beats.narration: The parameter counts show that DQ-CTM-SR is not the cheap end of this comparison. CATANet is the smallest reported model. RFDN is only slightly larger. IMDN remains below one million parameters. DQ-CTM-SR reaches one point one two nine million parameters, the second largest count among the five. CARN is larger still, at one point five nine two million parameters.

params.headline: DQ-CTM-SR has the second largest parameter count
